newsitem.title: USA: Second East Bayou Sorrel well set to produce.
newsitem.headline: Second East Bayou Sorrel well set to produce.

text.p: Pease Oil and Gas Co said Thursday the Schwing 2 was dually completed at its East Bayou Sorrel Field in Iberville Parish, La., and is being immediately connected to the field's recently constructed production facilities.
The Schwing 2 has about 74 feet of net pay in nine potentially productive zones in the 13,480 foot well bore. Completions were made in the Cib hazz 2 sand and Marg. howeii 1, 2 and 3 sands.

The Cib hazz 2 was completion flow tested at a rate of 912 barrels of oil and 1.0 million cubic feet of natural gas per day the three Marg. howeii sands tested at 575 barrels of oil and 1.2 million cubic feet of gas daily.
It is expected that the Schwing 2 will be produced at rates in excess of the above test rates, Pease Oil said.
The well's production will be added to the 1,400 barrels of oil and 1.4 million cubic feet of natural gas per day being produced from the Schwing 1 discovery well.
National Energy Group Inc is the operator of the East Bayou Sorrel Field and Pease Oil owns 10 percent of the working interest. Fortune Petroleum Corp is also a working interest owner in this field.
